boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lawrence University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Appleton food stops with current evening, midnight, or overnight availability verified through direct business and regional tourism pages. Confirm hours before leaving because schedules can change.

cards.title: Cookies After Midnight
cards.subtitle: Downtown on West College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk west from campus for cookies or ice cream, checking the bakery’s ordering page before setting out late.
cards.short_summary: A downtown bakery documented as operating past midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fox Cities Convention & Visitors Bureau lists the Appleton bakery at 318 W College Ave and reports closing at 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Wednesday, 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Friday, noon–3 a.m. Saturday, and noon–1 a.m. Sunday.

cards.title: The Latest Drive-Thru Window
cards.subtitle: North Richmond Street
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the overnight schedule; the official page shows the dining room closing much earlier.
cards.short_summary: An all-ages fast-food option with overnight drive-thru service throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru service until 4 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2810 N Richmond.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Appleton, WI — 2810 N Richmond
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours end at 4 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the page separately lists an 11 p.m. dine-in close.

cards.title: West College Overnight Stop
cards.subtitle: Farther west on College Avenue
cards.notes: Plan this as a drive-thru trip rather than a walk-in visit, since posted dining-room and drive-thru hours differ.
cards.short_summary: A West College Avenue counterpoint to downtown’s earlier-closing kitchens.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page lists the 2840 W College Avenue drive-thru until 3 a.m. Friday and 4 a.m. Saturday–Thursday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Appleton, WI — 2840 West College Avenue
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service is posted until 3 a.m. Friday and 4 a.m. Saturday–Thursday; Friday dine-in service ends at 11 p.m.

cards.title: East-Side Overnight Run
cards.subtitle: Near East College Avenue and Highway 441
cards.notes: Choose this east-side drive-thru when already traveling by car, and verify the day’s schedule before departure.
cards.short_summary: An overnight fast-food destination on Appleton’s east side.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page reports drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 3221 East Express Court.
cards.source_title: Fast Food Near Me in Appleton, WI — 3221 East Express Court | Taco Bell
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru service ends at 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: Pizza Until One
cards.subtitle: West Northland Avenue
cards.notes: Order delivery or carryout before the posted cutoff, allowing enough time for preparation on Friday or Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A north-side pizza option with weekend service extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists both delivery and carryout until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 902 W Northland Avenue.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns W Northland Ave | Papa Johns Appleton, WI
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are posted until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: East Calumet Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: East Calumet Street
cards.notes: Check the ordering screen before traveling; both pickup and delivery run later on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.short_summary: A second late pizza option serving Appleton’s eastern side.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns’ official location page lists delivery and carryout until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 4055 E Calumet Street.
cards.source_title: Food Near Me in Appleton, WI | Papa Johns E Calumet St
cards.access_notes: Both delivery and carryout are listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Weekend Custard Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: Westhill Boulevard
cards.notes: Use curbside or the drive-thru after the lobby closes, and arrive before midnight Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A weekend late run for a meal or frozen custard on Appleton’s west side.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s official location page lists curbside and drive-thru hours until midnight Thursday–Saturday at 599 N Westhill Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Culver’s of Appleton, WI — N Westhill Blvd
cards.access_notes: Curbside and drive-thru service runs until midnight Thursday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday; the lobby closes at 10 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery — 3030 E College Avenue
cards.title: Sit-Down Food Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: East College Avenue
cards.notes: Head east for a seated meal or bakery order, and arrive early enough to finish before the midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A daily midnight option with dine-in service and a broad breakfast-oriented menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins’ official Appleton location page lists restaurant hours from 5:30 a.m. to midnight every day at 3030 E College Avenue.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 3030 East College Ave., Appleton, WI
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists daily hours of 5:30 a.m.–midnight, including dine-in, pickup, curbside, and delivery services.

cards.title: Downtown Sandwich Cutoff
cards.subtitle: West College Avenue
cards.notes: Walk west from campus and place the order before 10 p.m.; the official page lists indoor seating plus pickup and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward downtown sandwich stop operating through 10 p.m. nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s official page lists store and delivery hours until 10 p.m. every day at 345 W College Avenue and confirms indoor seating.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Appleton | Jimmy John’s 0446
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours are posted as 11 a.m.–10 p.m. daily; delivery remains subject to availability and fees.

cards.title: Friday Custard Finale
cards.subtitle: Across College Avenue from campus
cards.notes: Cross into downtown for house-made cookies and frozen custard, targeting Friday or Saturday before 9:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: The closest late dessert run on this board, with extended weekend-evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The business’s official contact page lists its Appleton shop at 101 E College Avenue and closing at 9:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The shop closes at 9:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday, 9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday, and is listed as open daily.
